prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How You Want to Build Your Companion", "Select a premade buddy or create a customized desktop companion from scratch.", "Companion Path Selection"]
1: ["Interacting With Your New Pet", "Learn how to summon, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet anytime.", "Right-click your pet to access settings, hide it to the system tray, or start talking.", "Got It!"]
2: []
3: ["Photo Upload Guidelines", "For best pet generation, use well-lit photos with clear subject background contrast.", "Best Results Check", "Continue to Upload"]
4: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "Your pet is being prepared. This usually takes under 2 minutes.", "Desktop Tips"]
5: ["Signing in ensures your pet data and customizations are safely backed up to your account.", "Your pet data is automatically saved to your cloud profile upon sign in."]
6: ["Select Your Base Companion", "Choose from our available pet templates to get started."]
7: ["Select Your Onboarding Experience", "Pick 'Quick Start' to launch instantly, or 'Custom Pet' to generate a unique companion from your photos.", "You can always create additional pets later in app settings."]
8: ["We'll Notify You When Your Pet Is Ready", "Feel free to minimize this window. You will receive a desktop alert once setup completes."]
9: ["If your pet doesn't appear immediately, check your system tray or taskbar to unhide it.", "Welcome to your new desktop companion! Look for your pet walking around your main monitor."]
